set.academic_threshold: UAE certificate: Maths at 80% (General stream) or 70% (Advanced stream), plus 80% in High School English.

International curricula: High School English 80% (or TOEFL iBT 61), and Maths at the equivalent of 80% General / 70% Advanced: SAT Math 485, ACT 20, IB SL Maths 4, AP Maths 3, or IGCSE/AS/A-Level grade C. HCT admits international (non-Emirati) students only if they already live in the UAE.
UAE certificate: Maths and Physics at 80% (General stream) or 70% (Advanced stream), plus 80% in High School English.

International curricula: High School English 80% (or TOEFL iBT 61); Maths (SAT Math 485, ACT 20, IB SL Maths 4, AP Maths 3, or IGCSE/AS/A-Level grade C) and Physics (IGCSE/AS/A-Level grade C, IB SL Physics 4, or AP Physics 3). HCT admits international (non-Emirati) students only if they already live in the UAE.
